concepts.gloss_en: supporters of Torah (those who sustain Torah/Torah scholars)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are the same Aramaic phrase 'supporters of Torah' — one describing Israel as vav/supporters of Torah, the other describing money given to a Torah scholar as this same aspect. The vocalization differs only trivially (תָּמְכֵי vs תַּמְכֵי), which is normal pausal/orthographic variation of one word, not a homograph.
